statements.t: Management believes its liquidity position, available credit facilities, commercial paper program, and anticipated future contract termination proceeds provide sufficient resources to fund operations, capital expenditures, and debt obligations.

estimates.name: Factors Affecting Results — Master Indenture
estimates.t: As of September 30, 2026 , Tri-State had approximately $2.9 billion of secured indebtedness outstanding under its Master Indenture.

estimates.name: Margins and Patronage Capital
estimates.t: Tri-State operates on a cooperative basis and, accordingly, seeks only to generate revenues sufficient to recover its cost of service and to generate margins sufficient to meet certain financial requirements and to establish reasonable reserves.

estimates.name: Rates and Regulation
estimates.t: Tri-State's electric sales revenues are derived from wholesale electric service sales to the Utility Members and non-member purchasers.

estimates.name: Tax Status
estimates.t: Tri-State is a taxable cooperative subject to federal and state taxation.
